title: Severity of Scorpion Sting in Relation to Hematological Parameters
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to investigate the relationship between severity of envenomation and hematological parameter by detectig initial mean platelet volume (MPV), neutrophil/lymphocyte ratio (NLR) and platelet/lymphocyte ratio (PLR) in pediatric patients presenting with a scorpion sting.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* a) Patients presented with scorpion sting

Exclusion Criteria:

* All other envenomation or intoxications
study_population: study on children stung by scorpion
